title: Micro Assistant
description: Shows which counting relics and powers each card play affects - on the hovered card, and above the End Turn button.
changeNote: v0.8.0: Joss Paper (Exhaust cards advance it, Ethereal cards remind), Cloak Clasp (End Turn badge with the block it will grant), Paper Phrog (attacks while an enemy is Vulnerable), Intimidating Helmet (2+ cost cards). The gear menu now reports how many of the run relics and powers are tracked.
